tools.name: render_bar_chart
tools.description: Render a hand-drawn (sketchy) bar chart as a standalone SVG.

tools.name: render_line_chart
tools.description: Render a hand-drawn multi-series line chart as a standalone SVG.

tools.name: render_area_chart
tools.description: Render a hand-drawn filled area chart as a standalone SVG.

tools.name: render_scatter_plot
tools.description: Render a hand-drawn scatter / bubble plot as a standalone SVG.

tools.name: render_pie_chart
tools.description: Render a hand-drawn pie or donut chart as a standalone SVG.

tools.name: render_flowchart
tools.description: Render a hand-drawn flowchart (tree layout, four directions, rect/ellipse/diamond nodes, curved or orthogonal edges) as a standalone SVG.

tools.name: render_sankey
tools.description: Render a hand-drawn weighted flow (Sankey) diagram as a standalone SVG.

tools.name: render_treemap
tools.description: Render a hand-drawn treemap (nested rectangles sized by value) as a standalone SVG.

tools.name: render_heatmap
tools.description: Render a hand-drawn heatmap (grid of cells on a sequential color scale) as a standalone SVG.

tools.name: render_radar
tools.description: Render a hand-drawn radar / spider chart (polar multi-axis) as a standalone SVG.

tools.name: render_choropleth
tools.description: Render a hand-drawn US-states choropleth (states shaded by a numeric value) as a standalone SVG. Regions are 2-letter USPS codes.

tools.name: render_mind_map
tools.description: Render a hand-drawn mind map: a radial tree fanning out from a central root node, with straight spokes.

tools.name: render_org_chart
tools.description: Render a hand-drawn organisation chart: a tidy hierarchy of rectangular boxes joined by plain elbow connectors.

tools.name: render_architecture
tools.description: Render a hand-drawn architecture / network diagram: components (optionally grouped into zone containers via each node’s group) joined by connectors that route orthogonally around the other boxes.

tools.name: render_sequence
tools.description: Render a hand-drawn sequence / interaction diagram: actors with lifelines and ordered messages between them (reply messages dashed, self-messages loop back).

tools.name: render_er_diagram
tools.description: Render a hand-drawn entity-relationship diagram: titled entity boxes with field rows (PK/FK markers), joined by orthogonally routed connectors carrying cardinality markers.

tools.name: render_timeline
tools.description: Render a hand-drawn timeline: ordered events along a central axis (horizontal or vertical), labels alternating to either side.

tools.name: render_diagram
tools.description: Render any diagram from one high-level spec `{ kind, ... }`. Dispatches by kind to flowchart / sequence / mindmap / arch / er / timeline / org — the single entry point for diagrams.

tools.name: build_diagram_from_mermaid
tools.description: Parse a Mermaid snippet (flowchart/graph, sequenceDiagram, mindmap) and render it hand-drawn. Unsupported Mermaid features return a structured error rather than a crash.

tools.name: list_vibe_presets
tools.description: List every built-in vibe preset with its fully-resolved Rough.js knobs.

tools.name: resolve_vibe
tools.description: Resolve a vibe config (preset name or preset + overrides) into the full ResolvedVibe and the Rough.js options it maps to.

tools.name: preview_vibe
tools.description: Render a small sample (rectangle, line, circle, label) in the given vibe as SVG.

tools.name: compute_scale
tools.description: Build a d3 scale (linear/sqrt/band/point) and return its ticks, bandwidth and range.

tools.name: compute_ticks
tools.description: Return tick {value, offset} pairs for a scale spec.

tools.name: compute_line_path
tools.description: Build an SVG path `d` string through points (d3-shape line).

tools.name: compute_area_path
tools.description: Build an SVG path `d` string for a filled area down to a baseline (d3-shape area).

tools.name: compute_pie
tools.description: Compute pie/donut slice geometry (paths, centroids, angles) from category values.

tools.name: layout_tree
tools.description: Lay out flowchart nodes into a tidy tree (any direction); returns node + edge coordinates.

tools.name: compute_color_scale
tools.description: Map a numeric domain onto a named color scale: sample colors, plus the color for a specific value.

tools.name: profile_data
tools.description: Inspect an array of records and report field types/cardinality and the overall data shape (feeds chart recommendation).

tools.name: transform_data
tools.description: Reshape an array of records with a transform pipeline (sort, filter, topN, aggregate, bin, rolling, pivot) before charting. JSON in, JSON out.

tools.name: compute_regular_polygon_path
tools.description: Build a closed SVG path `d` for a regular n-gon centered at (cx,cy) with radius r. `rotation` is in degrees; 0 points the first vertex up (12 o’clock), positive rotates clockwise.

tools.name: compute_star_path
tools.description: Build a closed SVG path `d` for a star with `points` tips, alternating outerRadius/innerRadius around (cx,cy). `rotation` in degrees; 0 points the first tip up (12 o’clock), positive rotates clockwise.

tools.name: compute_arc_path
tools.description: Build an open SVG path `d` for an arc stroke from startAngle to endAngle (degrees, 0 = east, clockwise) at radius r around (cx,cy). No fill.

tools.name: compute_wedge_path
tools.description: Build a closed SVG path `d` for a pie wedge from startAngle to endAngle (degrees, 0 = east, clockwise) at radius r around (cx,cy). With innerRadius, builds an annular (ring) wedge.

tools.name: compute_arrowhead_path
tools.description: Build an SVG path `d` for an arrowhead at `to`, pointing along from->to. Open two-stroke head by default; `filled` closes it into a solid triangle.

tools.name: render_rough_path
tools.description: Render an SVG path `d` string as a sketched path inside a standalone SVG.

tools.name: render_rough_rect
tools.description: Render a sketched rectangle inside a standalone SVG.

tools.name: render_rough_circle
tools.description: Render a sketched circle inside a standalone SVG.

tools.name: render_rough_line
tools.description: Render a sketched line inside a standalone SVG.

tools.name: render_rough_text
tools.description: Render vibe-styled text inside a standalone SVG.

tools.name: compose_surface
tools.description: Render a list of scene nodes (primitives and positioned charts) into a single SVG with one shared vibe.

tools.name: build_flowchart_from_spec
tools.description: Render a flowchart, auto-assigning node shapes (entry/terminal -> ellipse, decision/branch -> diamond, else rect) unless shapes are given.

tools.name: export_svg
tools.description: Return an SVG as a data URI, or write it to an explicit `.svg` path. Writes only happen when a path is given.

tools.name: export_png
tools.description: Rasterize an SVG to PNG (via resvg). Returns base64, or writes to an explicit `.png` path. Writes only happen when a path is given.

tools.name: export_interactive_html
tools.description: Wrap a GoldenChart SVG into a self-contained interactive HTML document with hover tooltips (a vanilla hydrator reads the embedded data-gc-* contract — no runtime deps). Returns the HTML, or writes it to an explicit `.html` path. Writes only happen when a path is given.

tools.name: visualize_data
tools.description: Profile raw records, auto-pick the best-fit chart, and render it as SVG. Optionally pass a plain-English `query` (e.g. "revenue by month as a line in pencil") to steer the chart type, field roles, and vibe. Returns the chosen chart with its rationale, ranked alternatives, and — when a query is given — how the query was interpreted.

query.description: Plain-English description, e.g. "compare revenue by region as a pie".

tools.name: suggest_improvements
tools.description: Profile data, pick the best-fit chart, and critique it for common dataviz mistakes (too many categories, label collisions, misleading pies, too many colours, …). Returns actionable critiques (with fix patches) an agent can act on in a refine loop, plus the rendered chart.

tools.name: render_with_revision
tools.description: Apply a revision patch (typically the `fix` from a `suggest_improvements` critique) to the original data and re-render. Returns the new SVG, the chart pick, the revisions that were applied, and a fresh critique pass so an agent can decide whether to iterate again.

tools.name: render-badge
tools.description: Renders a GoldenChart Badge (label/value pill) as a self-contained SVG. No network.

tools.name: render-github-badge
tools.description: Fetches a single metric from GitHub (anonymous or with $GITHUB_TOKEN) and renders it as a hand-drawn Badge SVG. Note: the `workflow` arg, when present, is passed to GitHub as `workflow_id`, which accepts the numeric workflow ID or the workflow file name (e.g. `ci.yml`), NOT the human-readable display name; pass a file name to filter, or omit it to get the latest run across any workflow.

tools.name: render-github-badge-row
tools.description: Resolves multiple GitHub metrics (with cached + deduplicated fetches) and renders them as a single SVG row of hand-drawn Badges.

tools.name: build_chart_from_fusioncharts
tools.description: Translate a FusionCharts config (JSON `{type, dataSource}`) into a GoldenChart render. Supports the common bar/column, line, area, pie/doughnut, scatter/bubble, and maps/usa families; unsupported chart types return a structured error rather than a wrong render.
